//: OPS-001: an Invariant for every repository.
text: Never push to a default or protected branch, force-push except `--force-with-lease` on a branch you created, delete branches or tags, or merge your own PR.
why: The standards end feature work with --force-with-lease on the author's own branch, and an agent once pushed to main on an old approval.
enforced_by: rulesets that require a pull request and block force-pushes and deletion
the Claude cloud git proxy, which rejects branch deletions and tag pushes
Copilot's cloud agent, which cannot merge
to_add: no admin bypass for agent identities, or a non-admin App identity for unattended agents
a hook that blocks plain --force, push --delete, tag pushes and gh pr merge
